idea-plugin.name: Gopher Burrow
idea-plugin.description:
Dark theme for GoLand, built on Islands Dark and tuned for OLED screens.

  • Real black around the panels, soft violet where you read.
  • Go code you can scan at a glance: types, functions and fields each get their own color.
  • The same colors follow you into YAML, SQL, Dockerfiles and the rest of the repo.

Source code and issues on GitHub. Stars make the gopher happy.

Not affiliated with or endorsed by Google, the Go project or JetBrains.
